nodes.text: [i]He is small, and he is gripping the book so tightly his knuckles have gone pale. The page in his lap is blank.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.text: I read the last page. I read it before anyone could tell me it was safe to.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.text: And after that nothing felt like it mattered, because I already knew how it ended.
[i]You hold out the lantern. You can't tell him how it ends. You don't know. Nobody does.[/i]
[i]It is. It is also the only way a story gets to keep going.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.text: Will you stay while I turn it?
[i]He turns the page. Nothing terrible happens. A new sentence begins to write itself, slowly, in handwriting that looks a great deal like his.[/i]
